title: A Garden for the Oath
author: Paloma Eastwick
blurb: Mirabel Vane, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
